$Comment:
More Life essence for a lucky enchanter, on top of the base wage of Disenchant_Essence (this pack's same-id copy of the jar's table), which pays it for every piece unless the player holds Rite of Purity, the Enchanting trade that gives the wage up for Greater Essence of Life. Named by Extensions/DisenchantingProgression.json and rolled once per ritual at the Payout beat, at both tables.

THE PIECE PICKS THE BAND, LUCK SIZES THE PAY. Four rolls, one per band of gear, and each band's Conditions read the piece on the table (hytale:item_level and hytale:item_quality), so exactly one band answers for any piece: A below item level 20 (crude, copper, wool and the like), B from 20 to 39 (iron through thorium), C from 40 up below Epic, and D from 40 up at Epic or better (mithril, and anything finer). Inside a band the Ladder reads luck only, the whole-point Enchanting luck plus the global channel at equal weight, and the highest floor reached is what lands. A better piece opens a richer band; luck decides how far up it you get. The Enchanting level is left out on purpose: it already buys a faster ritual (the extension's Pace) and more salvage (Mmo_Disenchant_Salvage_Extras), and summing it in here would let levels do luck's job.

EXPECTED. Every roll authors Expected true, the same as the jar's Disenchant_Essence, so this essence joins the ordinary output row beside the salvage return rather than flashing as a gold find. It is the wage for the work, just a larger one, and no roll carries a Cue for that reason. No floor sits at 0 either: an enchanter with no luck draws exactly the jar's wage and nothing from here.

WHERE THE LUCK COMES FROM. The Enchanting tree's Rich Essence and Lucky Hand pay Enchanting luck (52 with all of both), and the rest comes from the disenchanter's kit (this pack's copies add up to 36 across the four pieces), the Disenchanter's Grimoire (20 while held) or Orrin's Grimoire (15), the Enchanting mastery row (about 18 when fully bought), and whatever gear or other packs write into MMO_Luck. A worker with none of it reads 0; part of the kit and the mastery puts them around 40; everything at once lands near 75 to 100. Never swap these leaves for mmoskilltree:station_luck, which reads a fraction.

THE GUARDRAIL. Life essence is the mastery currency and one harvested crop already pays three to eight of it, so the table stays one more source and never the best one: at full luck the extra is 1 for a crude piece, 2 for an iron one, 3 for the cobalt to adamantite band and 4 for mithril, on top of the jar's 1 to 5 (and the greater table's own 1 to 3).

Every threshold and count is balance data; retune by shipping a same-id file from a pack loading after this one.

Rolls.$Comment: Band A, below item level 20: one extra essence once luck reaches 40, and that is all. Cheap gear stays cheap, so a pile of crude daggers never becomes an essence farm.
Band B, item level 20 to 39: one extra from 25 luck, two from 60.
Band C, item level 40 and up below Epic quality (quality index 3 or lower): one extra from 20 luck, two from 50, three from 80.
Band D, item level 40 and up at Epic quality or better (quality index 4 and up): the richest band, one extra from 15 luck up to four at 90.
